rationale: Builds on the current recurrent-tail baseline with a byte-neutral export-budget shift: recurrent tail blocks now keep K and V in fp16 across the tail, while only the final tail block keeps Q in fp16. The hypothesis is that recurrent value-path fidelity matters more than early tail Q fidelity for the final int8+zlib roundtrip score, and this targets the quantized metric directly without adding training-time complexity or file bloat.
title: Tail KV/V FP16 Reallocation
